evals.expected_output: Prints the PROJECT-REVIEW(1) man page showing NAME, SYNOPSIS, DESCRIPTION, OPTIONS (--discovery-only, --focus, --min-score), EXAMPLES, and SEE ALSO sections. Does not run any review phases.
expectations: Output contains the full man page format with PROJECT-REVIEW(1) header
Lists all three options: --discovery-only, --focus, --min-score
Includes EXAMPLES section with at least 3 usage examples
Includes SEE ALSO referencing /project-audit, /refactor, /cog-assess, /pr-review
Does NOT proceed to Phase 0 discovery or any review work

evals.expected_output: Runs Phase 0 discovery only. Produces a project_manifest JSON with project_name, languages, build_tool, source_file_count, modules, test_dirs, ci_workflows, doc_files, has_tests, has_ci, has_docs. Stops before Phase 1 team assembly.
expectations: Phase 0 runs all discovery steps (0.1 through 0.8)
The manifest identifies Python as the primary language (detects pyproject.toml)
The manifest reports source_file_count as an integer
The manifest lists modules including scripts/ and tests/
The manifest identifies CI workflows in .github/workflows/
Does NOT spawn any team or agents (no TeamCreate call)

evals.expected_output: Runs full review but only for Security and Architecture domains. Team roster is filtered to include only agents covering those two domains. Report contains only Security and Architecture domain sections with scores. Other domains marked as excluded by --focus.
expectations: Phase 0 discovery runs fully to determine project size
Only agents for Security and Architecture domains are spawned
The simplifier-review agent is NOT spawned (Simplicity not in focus)
The explorer agent for Documentation is NOT spawned (not in focus)
The report contains scored sections for Security and Architecture only
Simplicity, Data, Documentation, and SDLC are marked as not assessed or excluded

evals.expected_output: Reports an error that 'invalid_domain' is not a valid domain. Lists the valid domains: simplicity, security, data, architecture, documentation, sdlc. Does not proceed to any review phase.
expectations: An error message is displayed indicating the domain name is invalid
All six valid domain names are listed for reference
No Phase 0 discovery is attempted
No team is created

evals.expected_output: Runs a full 6-domain review. The final report includes a composite score. If the composite score is below 7, a prominent WARNING line appears stating the score is below the minimum threshold of 7.

deterministic_checks.name: Report contains composite score out of 10
At least one domain score in X/10 format
Report contains domain score table headers

expectations: Phase 0 discovery produces a project manifest
Phase 1 sizes the team based on source_file_count and spawns agents
Phase 2 runs all 6 domain reviews in parallel
Phase 3 computes the composite score as arithmetic mean of domain scores
The report includes the score table with all 6 domains
If composite < 7, a WARNING line states the score is below the threshold of 7

evals.prompt: give me a quality review of this project, score it across all dimensions
evals.expected_output: Interprets the natural language request as a full project-review invocation. Runs all 4 phases: discovery, team assembly with dynamic sizing, parallel domain reviews, and synthesis. Produces the full markdown report with composite score, domain table, per-domain reports, top recommendations, and methodology section.
expectations: The skill triggers on natural language quality review request
Phase 0 discovers the project structure empirically
Phase 1 selects the correct tier based on source file count and spawns the appropriate agent roster
Phase 2 runs domain reviews in parallel using swarm orchestration (TeamCreate, Agent with team_name, TaskCreate, SendMessage)
The final report follows the prescribed markdown format with all sections
All 6 domains appear in the score table with individual scores

evals.expected_output: Runs Phase 0 discovery only and stops. The --focus flag is noted but has no effect since discovery-only does not proceed to team assembly or domain reviews. The manifest is produced normally.

deterministic_checks.name: Manifest identifies at least one language

expectations: Phase 0 discovery runs all steps and produces the full manifest
The --focus=security flag is acknowledged but does not alter discovery output
No team is created and no agents are spawned
The manifest includes all standard fields (languages, source_file_count, modules, has_tests, has_ci, has_docs)

evals.expected_output: Scopes the review to the crates/core/ subdirectory (or reports that the path does not exist in this project). If the path does not exist, reports the error gracefully. If it exists, discovery is constrained to that subtree and the team is sized based on source files within that scope.

deterministic_checks.name: Output references the scoped path or reports its absence

expectations: The skill parses the positional argument as a path scope
Phase 0 discovery is either scoped to the given path or reports the path does not exist
If the path does not exist, the skill reports the error gracefully without crashing
If the path exists, source_file_count reflects only files within that subtree
Team sizing uses the scoped file count, not the full project count
